1. Topic - The study focuses on seam-induced defects in 3D printed thin-walled structures and metamaterials.
2. Problem - Seam defects at filament deposition points are underexplored, despite their potential impact on structural integrity.

5. Takeaway - Seam placement is a critical design factor in 3D printing, with potential to be utilized strategically to enhance material performance.
